omissions: Full historical logs, binary artifacts, source inventories and passing traces are linked through immutable app evidence or retained core audit manifests; not duplicated here. Successful79ba CI full logs and artifact ZIP are omitted with original audit/artifact inventories retained. Canonical8f raw logs/results/traces contain authentication material and must remain private; only separately reviewed sanitized receipts may be copied. Postmerge8f successful full logs and original ZIPs/traces are omitted with original hash/CRC inventory retained; raw postmerge artifacts were not screened for authentication content and remain private.

historicalPrivateEncodingReceipts.encoding: RFC4648 base64 with LF line wrapping; decode reproduces the original ZIP byte-for-byte.
historicalPrivateEncodingReceipts.reason: Raw ZIP triggers202 false text-signature matches in the existing core text-integrity scanner. No scanner exemption or archived-byte mutation was introduced.
